integrity: Proof includes distinct complete automorphism-group orbits, and a finite-field combinatorial checker is provided with its exact limits.
scientific_limitations: Smooth complete complex toric varieties of Picard number two only. The abstract orbit partition is covered by the general criterion of Bazhov; claimed structural refinement concerns explicit vector-bundle identifications and motivic classes. Historic priority may be incomplete. No independent audit.
title: Explicit automorphism-orbit bundles for smooth toric varieties of Picard number two
